description: Strategies from THIS account's history that held up under out-of-sample and walk-forward checks, not merely ones that made money. Ranked by worst walk-forward fold — consistency, not size. Answers what has worked on this account so far without re-running anything.

order.description: 'consistency' (default) sorts by worst walk-forward fold, then median fold. 'pnl' sorts by total P&L and is the ranking most likely to put an overfit at the top.

name: list_strategies
